germplasm.name: GENESYS PGR
germplasm.coverage: plant genetic resources accessions from CGIAR and national genebanks
germplasm.provenance_notes: Use accessionNumber, instituteCode, taxonomy, geography, and DOI/passport fields where available.

germplasm.name: USDA GRIN-Global / NPGS
germplasm.coverage: USDA National Plant Germplasm System accessions and taxonomy
germplasm.provenance_notes: Use for accession provenance, taxonomy, institute, biological status, and collection metadata.

germplasm.name: GBIF Species API
germplasm.coverage: taxonomy matching, species names, higher taxonomy, occurrence support
germplasm.provenance_notes: Use species matching and occurrence search to normalize botanical names and distribution evidence.

phenotyping.name: Crop Ontology
phenotyping.coverage: crop trait dictionaries, methods, scales, and ontology identifiers
phenotyping.provenance_notes: Use as source authority for observation variable names, methods, and scale metadata.

phenotyping.name: BrAPI V2 Test Server
phenotyping.update_frequency: test server refreshes as BrAPI examples evolve
phenotyping.coverage: example variables, observations, studies, trials, germplasm
phenotyping.provenance_notes: Use for contract-shaped sample responses and BrAPI schema alignment, not as production truth.

phenotyping.name: CGIAR Dataverse
phenotyping.format: CSV, XLSX, JSON metadata, tabular datasets
phenotyping.coverage: crop research datasets from CGIAR centers
phenotyping.provenance_notes: Use dataset citations and license metadata when importing observed phenotypes.

genotyping.name: Ensembl Plants
genotyping.coverage: plant reference genomes, gene models, variation resources
genotyping.provenance_notes: Use for reference sets, genes, coordinates, and genome map metadata.

genotyping.name: NCBI Datasets / Assembly
genotyping.coverage: reference assemblies and genome annotation packages
genotyping.provenance_notes: Use assembly accession and BioProject metadata for reference provenance.

genotyping.name: Gramene
genotyping.format: genomic database exports and web APIs
genotyping.coverage: comparative plant genomics, pathways, QTL and gene resources
genotyping.provenance_notes: Use for crop genome context and gene/QTL links where available.

trials.name: BrAPI V2 Test Server Studies
trials.update_frequency: test server refreshes as BrAPI examples evolve

trials.name: CGIAR Dataverse Trial Data
trials.coverage: international crop trial datasets and metadata
trials.provenance_notes: Use with citation and license metadata for trial observations.

trials.name: FAOSTAT Crops and Livestock Products
trials.coverage: area harvested, production quantity, yield, country/year/crop series
trials.provenance_notes: Use for crop-level yield baselines, not plot-level trial truth.

observations.name: BrAPI V2 Test Server Observations
observations.update_frequency: test server refreshes as BrAPI examples evolve
observations.provenance_notes: Use for shape validation and sample response tests.

observations.name: Crop Ontology Trait Scales
observations.coverage: trait methods, scales, and valid values
observations.provenance_notes: Use to validate trait-value ranges and observation variable metadata.

observations.name: FAOSTAT Yield Series
observations.provenance_notes: Use to anchor synthetic plot-scale yield distributions.

seed_bank.name: GENESYS PGR
seed_bank.provenance_notes: Use for accession and donor metadata.

seed_bank.name: Svalbard Global Seed Vault Data Portal
seed_bank.coverage: safety duplicate seed deposits by institute and crop
seed_bank.provenance_notes: Use for conservation context, not tenant inventory quantities.

seed_bank.name: USDA GRIN-Global
seed_bank.coverage: plant germplasm collections, requests, taxonomy, inventories
seed_bank.provenance_notes: Use for accession source and inventory-like conservation signals.

environmental.name: NASA POWER Daily API
environmental.coverage: solar and meteorological data for agroclimatology
environmental.provenance_notes: Use for GDD, rainfall, photothermal and stress-index enrichment.

environmental.name: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API
environmental.provenance_notes: Use for fallback public weather enrichment where license permits.

environmental.name: ISRIC SoilGrids
environmental.provenance_notes: Use for soil profile defaults and uncertainty-aware soil context.

field_operations.name: BrAPI Field Layout Surfaces
field_operations.coverage: observation units, locations, studies, and events
field_operations.provenance_notes: Use for field-book compatible schema shapes.

field_operations.name: Field Book App Exports
field_operations.provenance_notes: Use as local/manual data source when operators upload exports.

field_operations.name: NASA POWER Agroclimatology
field_operations.provenance_notes: Use to enrich planting, irrigation, and stress context.

gwas.name: GWAS Catalog
gwas.coverage: published GWAS associations, mostly human but useful API pattern and selected plant studies
gwas.provenance_notes: Use plant records where available and always cite source study.

gwas.name: Rice 3K / SNP-Seek
gwas.provenance_notes: Use for rice marker positions and association context.

gwas.name: CIMMYT Research Data
gwas.format: Dataverse metadata, CSV, VCF, phenotype/genotype packages
gwas.coverage: maize and wheat breeding, genomics, and phenotyping datasets
gwas.provenance_notes: Use dataset DOI and license metadata when importing GWAS-ready data.

qtls.name: Gramene QTL and Gene Resources
qtls.coverage: plant comparative genomics, gene annotations, QTL links
qtls.provenance_notes: Use for candidate gene and interval context.

qtls.name: QTARO
qtls.provenance_notes: Use for rice trait/QTL names, intervals, and publications.

economics.name: FAOSTAT Crops and Livestock Products
economics.coverage: production, yield, harvested area, country/year/crop series
economics.provenance_notes: Use for crop production and yield economics baselines.

economics.name: World Bank Pink Sheet
economics.provenance_notes: Use for market price trend anchoring.

economics.name: Agmarknet
economics.coverage: Indian agricultural market arrivals and prices
economics.provenance_notes: Use for India market region price context where accessible.

social.name: FAO e-Agriculture Knowledge Platform
social.coverage: extension and digital agriculture knowledge themes
social.provenance_notes: Use only for cited public knowledge snippets, not synthetic user identity.

social.name: CGIAR Knowledge Resources
social.coverage: crop research publications and extension-like material
social.provenance_notes: Use for source-attributed knowledge post templates.

social.name: Tenant-Safe Synthetic Social Fixtures

social.provenance_notes: Use for demo-only social data; never label generated community content as real.
